```{r Renaming rupture Y/N variables}
# Copy original column
New_Spleen$rupture <- New_Spleen$`Ruptured?`

# Clean values
New_Spleen$rupture[grepl("^no", New_Spleen$rupture, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "no"
New_Spleen$rupture[New_Spleen$rupture %in% c("np")] <- NA
New_Spleen$rupture[grepl("^yes", New_Spleen$rupture, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "yes"
New_Spleen$rupture[grepl("ruptured", New_Spleen$rupture, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "yes"
New_Spleen$rupture[New_Spleen$rupture %in% c("ys")] <- "yes"
New_Spleen$rupture[New_Spleen$rupture %in% c("one-tail-9x10cm")] <- "yes"

# Force everything else to NA
New_Spleen$rupture[!New_Spleen$rupture %in% c("yes","no")] <- NA

# Convert to factor
New_Spleen$rupture <- as.factor(New_Spleen$rupture)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

New_Spleen <- New_Spleen %>%
  # Step 1: Trim extra spaces
  mutate(location_clean_new = trimws(location_clean_new)) %>%
  
  # Step 2: Create logical vectors for each category
  mutate(
    has_head = grepl("head", location_clean_new, ignore.case = TRUE),
    has_body = grepl("body|midbody", location_clean_new, ignore.case = TRUE),
    has_tail = grepl("tail", location_clean_new, ignore.case = TRUE),
    has_diffuse = grepl("diffuse", location_clean_new, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) 
 
```



```{r}
num_locs_new <- as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(has_head), FALSE, has_head)) +
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(has_body), FALSE, has_body)) +
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(has_tail), FALSE, has_tail)) +
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(has_diffuse), FALSE, has_diffuse))

  
```



```{r}
New_Spleen$location_group_new[num_locs_new > 1] <- "Multiple"

New_Spleen$location_group_new[num_locs_new == 1 & has_head] <- "Head"

New_Spleen$location_group_new[num_locs_new == 1 & has_body] <- "Body"

New_Spleen$location_group_new[num_locs_new == 1 & has_tail] <- "Tail"

New_Spleen$location_group_new[num_locs_new == 1 & has_diffuse] <- "Diffuse"
```

```{r}
# Still not working... final try
library(dplyr)

New_Spleen$location_clean3 <- New_Spleen$`Location of mass`

# Clean location and create location_group
New_Spleen <- New_Spleen %>%
  mutate(location_clean3 = tolower(trimws(location_clean3))) %>%  # lowercase + trim spaces
  mutate(
    has_head = grepl("head", location_clean3),
    has_body = grepl("body|midbody", location_clean3),
    has_tail = grepl("tail", location_clean3),
    has_diffuse = grepl("diffuse", location_clean3)
  ) %>%
  
  # Count how many locations exist
  mutate(num_locs3 = has_head + has_body + has_tail + has_diffuse) %>%
  
  # Assign final location_group
  mutate(location_group_new = case_when(
    num_locs3 > 1 ~ "Multiple",                 # nodules in multiple locations
    num_locs3 == 1 & has_head ~ "Head",
    num_locs3 == 1 & has_body ~ "Body",
    num_locs3 == 1 & has_tail ~ "Tail",
    num_locs3 == 1 & has_diffuse ~ "Diffuse",
    num_locs3 == 0 ~ "Unknown"                 # nothing matched
  )) 

New_Spleen$location_group_new[New_Spleen$location_group_new == "Unknown"] <- NA
  
```

```{r}
New_Spleen$location_group2 <- ifelse(
  num_locs2 > 2, "Multiple_3plus",
  ifelse(
    num_locs2 == 2, "Two",
    ifelse(
      num_locs2 == 1 & has_head2, "Head",
      ifelse(
        num_locs2 == 1 & has_body2, "Body",
        ifelse(
          num_locs2 == 1 & has_tail2, "Tail",
          ifelse(
            num_locs2 == 1 & has_diffuse2, "Diffuse",
            NA
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Logistic regression:

# Making one the reference group:
number_and_location2$`Number of nodules` <- 
  relevel(number_and_location2$`Number of nodules`, ref = "one")

logreg_loc <- glm(rupture ~ `Number of nodules`,
             data = number_and_location2,
             family = binomial)
summary(logreg_loc)
```
```{r}
exp(coef(logreg_loc))
```

```{r}
library(mosaic)
numandlocinteract <- glm(
  rupture ~ `Number of nodules` * location_group2,
  data = number_and_location2,
  family = binomial)
msummary(numandlocinteract)

# Result: There is definitely not enough data (not enough multiple nodules in each unique location seperately) to include an interaction. 
```
